description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not specify this parameter for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

description.zh: 场景联动规则内容。格式详情请参见[场景联动规则编写说明](~~171059~~)。
description.en: The content of the scene orchestration rule. For details about the format, see [Scene Orchestration Rule Writing Guide](~~171059~~).

description.zh: 场景联动规则描述。长度不超过100个字符。
description.en: The description of the scene orchestration rule. The description can be up to 100 characters in length.

description.zh: 场景联动规则ID。调用[QuerySceneRule](~~169498~~)接口获取场景联动规则ID。
description.en: The ID of the scene orchestration rule. You can call the [QuerySceneRule](~~169498~~) API to obtain the rule ID.

description.zh: 场景联动规则的名称。支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度限制为1~30个字符。
description.en: The name of the scene orchestration rule. The name can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must be 1 to 30 characters in length.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Conditions
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 10 queries per second (QPS) to invoke this API.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
